title: DOPPIS – Diabetes Outreach Prevention Programmes International (DOPPIS)

text: Slide 2DOPPSI COVID 19 OUTREACHSlide 2Diabetes Professional Care 2019 Industry AwardsHIGHLY COMMENDED CHARITY Slide 1You can manage your diabetes.We can help. Slide 3THE VISION/ OBJECT Of DOPPSI is“The preservation and protection of good health of people at risk of or who have diabetes in developing countries with particular emphasis on the poor and needy sectors of communities who are unable to afford the cost of healthcare by the provision of education, training and outreach programmes focused on prevention, treatment, rehabilitation and support for all impacted by Diabetes” READ MORE Welcome Diabetes Outreach Prevention Programmes International (DOPPIS) is an international charitable organisation that aspires towards the education of peoples from all walks of life about diabetes prevention. Our Mission is dedicated to provide education on prevention, early diagnosis and access to treatment of diabetes in the UK and worldwide.
